findings.evidence: `AssociatedGraded`/`GradedPiece`/`gradedMul` take an arbitrary `f : M →ₗ[R] A` under `[CommRing R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Ring A] [Algebra R A]` (AssociatedGraded.lean:86-121), and `pbwFiltration R L k = TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R).toLinearMap k` by `rfl` (PBW/Basic.lean:81-84), so no further construction is needed for the instantiation the sentence defers.
findings.fix: Replace with a statement of what is delivered, e.g. "Instantiated at `(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R).toLinearMap`, whose word filtration is `pbwFiltration`, it is the associated-graded algebra of the PBW filtration; the remaining PBW work is the comparison with `SymmetricAlgebra R L`."
findings.issue: The overview says "The PBW filtration ... is also a word filtration, so this construction applies at `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R` once its associated graded is built". The condition is vacuous and misleading: this file *is* the associated-graded construction, it is generic in `f`, and `AssociatedGraded (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R).toLinearMap` is already the associated graded of `pbwFiltration` — the PR description states exactly that. A reader is told the PBW associated graded does not yet exist and may rebuild it.

summary: Documentation of the new generic file is otherwise complete and accurate, and no docstring still cites a deleted declaration or old module path. One sentence in the new module docstring is self-contradictory: it defers the PBW associated graded to future work although the generic construction already delivers it at `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R`.
